EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Schedule a Revision Meeting
EmailTemplate.subject: Request to Schedule a Planning Meeting
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Client Contact>,
I hope you're well.
[If pre renewal] I'd like to schedule time to review an Executive Service Summary with you in advance of your renewal with Insperity. This report provides a high-level overview of the projects, services plans, and general services you and your employees have engaged in and benefitted from during your last year with Insperity. It can assist as a roadmap in demonstrating the value of your relationship with Insperity and provide an outline of and direction for your future goals.
[If post renewal] Thank you so much for your renewal and reinvestment in the Insperity(R) relationship. I look forward to our continued partnership and would like to schedule time with you to discuss your business's future goals. In this meeting we will review an Executive Service Summary, a report that report provides a high-level overview of the projects, services plans, and general services you and your employees have engaged in and benefitted from during your last year with Insperity. It can assist as a roadmap in demonstrating the value of your relationship with Insperity and provide an outline of and direction for your future goals.
Let me know if either of the times below will work for you or provide an alternative suggestion. I will send a calendar invitation under separate email once confirmed.
Wednesday, December 9th at 10:30 a.m. CT
Friday, December 11th at 3 p.m. CT
Thank you for trusting Insperity to serve your business. I look forward to meeting with you.
[signature]
